policy.method: Independent Fraction GD closed form; unrolled momentum with recurrence assertion; integer LCG; Fraction Adam weighted moments and bias correction with Decimal(80) sqrt/updates

schema.sections: stability, momentum, batches, adam; each is [{config,expected:[step,...]}]
schema.batchStep: rngBefore,rngAfter,indices,perExampleGradients; gradient is the average of ordered per-example gradients
schema.length: K transitions with k=0..K-1, or a prefix ending at the first non-finite step; 0<=K<=40

policy.quadratic: a*(x-center)^2/2+2*y^2, gradient=(a*(x-center),4*y); a>0 and center finite with at most two decimal places
policy.batchLoss: r=w*x+b-target; per-example loss=r^2/2, gradient=(r*x,r); full loss is the mean over all four examples
policy.batchSelection: full=[0,1,2,3] without RNG advance; stochastic draws one; mini draws batchSize=1..4 with replacement
policy.adam: m1=(1-b1)*sum(b1^(t-1-j)*g_j); m2=(1-b2)*sum(b2^(t-1-j)*g_j^2); hats divide by 1-b**t; update=-eta*m1Hat/(sqrt(m2Hat)+eps)
policy.adamSequence: source=sequence supplies exactly K gradients, independent of any objective; loss and nextLoss are null; source=quadratic evaluates gradients at Decimal(80) iterates
policy.invalid: Invalid configuration raises ValueError; computed non-finite outputs null every mathematical field and stop the trace; JSON NaN and Infinity are forbidden

tolerance.rationale: Exact rational steps and Decimal(80) Adam values are rounded only on export; allow accumulated browser roundings over at most 40 updates and bias-correction cancellation
tolerance.zeroDecayTrajectory: Near zero with beta1=beta2=0, independently check each real transition at its actual binary64 inputs; an ideal-arithmetic trajectory is ill-conditioned there. The same 128-ulp allowance applies, without a widened path tolerance.
tolerance.exact: Statuses, nulls, zero outputs, step/time indices, RNG states and selected indices match exactly
